title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon County Fair on 1982-08-28

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the legendary Aug 28 1982 Oregon Country Fair show—smoking West L.A. Fadeaway, powerful Black Peter and a triumphant Dupree’s Diamond Blues—delivered in a clear, bottom‑heavy mix.
ai_review.review: The recording preserves one of the most celebrated Dead outings at the Oregon Country Fair in 1982, featuring debuting tunes like West L.A. Fadeaway and a fiery return of Dupree’s Diamond Blues alongside classic highlights such as Black Peter, Althea and China Cat. Reviewers praise Jerry’s searing guitar work, Brent’s hot keys, Phil’s booming low end and Mickey’s fire‑filled drumming, noting the soundboard source is crisp though a bit low‑level at times.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 detailed reviews overwhelmingly rate the show five stars, praising both performance and recording; minor level issues do not detract from an otherwise excellent soundboard capture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with strong bottom end; a few reviewers note the overall levels are slightly low but no drop‑outs or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Eclectic mix of new material and classics; high‑energy first set followed by a jam‑heavy second set that builds to a powerful encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for searing guitar tone, inventive turnarounds, envelope‑filter wizardry and spot‑on leads throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as having a massive low‑end presence that ‘blurred vision’; bass is strong and driving.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as intense, “coming out of his pants,” adding fire to the performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) noted as hot, delivering straight‑ahead piano, organ slashing and solid support for jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s drumming is called ‘on fire’ and energetic, especially during the Playin’/Drums segment.
